# UC-LEARN10 — Orchestration SDK (Custom UI)

**Track:** learn  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  


## Buyer Story

Teams want their own sign-in UI without giving up orchestration — and without shipping an app release every time the flow changes.

## PingOne Solution

The Ping Orchestration SDK (@forgerock/davinci-client) runs a DaVinci flow with response_mode=pi.flow and hands the app collectors — a description of what the flow needs next — so the app renders every field itself while the flow stays editable in DaVinci.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/orchestration-sdk","label":"Open Orchestration SDK"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `GUIDED_LEARNING`

## What to Say

> Three ways to run a DaVinci flow — redirect, hosted widget, or the SDK. Only the SDK lets you render the screens, and all three are live in this demo against the same flow.
